doc: Automated listening and critique of a delivered MP4 or WAV. Every check reports a measured value, pass / warn / fail against the pack spec (or a stated house default) and a concrete fix with timestamps. It measures; it does not replace one human listen.
deps: numpy, scipy, ffmpeg (decode). Optional mood labels: a LOCAL CLAP checkpoint in EARS_CLAP_MODEL plus transformers and torch; nothing is downloaded.

ears/loudness.doc: integrated LUFS (BS.1770-4 K-weighting, gated), short-term curve, LRA (EBU Tech 3342), sample and 4x-oversampled true peak, platform offsets, last 0.15 s digital silence

ears/clipping.doc: flat-topped clipped-sample runs, intersample overs (4x oversampled), crest factor and PLR

ears/tone.doc: band energy per octave relative to the 500 Hz-2 kHz mid band: sub, low, mud, mid, presence, sibilance, air; mud / boomy / thin / harsh / sibilant / dull flags with time ranges

ears/speech.doc: speech regions (energy + spectral VAD, or a transcript), speech-to-music ratio in 300 Hz-3.4 kHz, ducking depth, masking, words per minute

ears/sync.doc: tempo + confidence, beat grid, onsets and hits, audible event on frames 0-3, cuts within 2 frames of an onset or beat, cue anchors on F + 1, risers ending one frame before the hit; mode music | vo | continuous decides what the edit is scored on (cuts on onsets, speech continuity, or motion events on onsets); a planned quiet open (plan.audio.quiet) waives the frame-0 event
ears/sync.source: SKILL.md hard rule 4, music/README.md R1 / R10, references/critic.md

ears/structure.doc: energy and novelty curves, sections (intro / build / drop / body / outro), drop time as a share of the runtime, the breath before the final sting, loop seam, near-silent stretches (dead air unless planned in plan.audio.quiet) and the ending shape (slam, sustained sub, quiet hold, decay, level)
ears/structure.source: references/launch-playbook.md (silence before the payoff), SKILL.md virality checklist

ears/repetition.doc: the same SFX-like onset (spectrally near-identical, not on the music's beat) repeated too often in a window; same cue id repeated in the plan

ears/stereo.doc: L/R correlation, mono-compatibility (loudness lost when summed to mono), width (side vs mid)

ears/compare.doc: with --ref study.json files (tools/refstudy.py): loudness-curve shape, band shares, tempo, brightness, cuts on onsets, quiet open and quiet tail against the references; with plan.audio.role (or --role) the bass share against the round 4/5 range for that role

ears/ab_replay.doc: the before / after audio swap (cuts/story78.py abReplay): the two halves are level-matched (integrated LUFS within plan.audio.abReplay.tol_db, 1 dB; warn to 2 dB) and the sound changes ON the picture's flip frame (the largest log-spectral change within 0.5 s of it sits within 1 frame, stands out from the local median, and is the only big change there); n/a without plan.audio.abReplay
ears/ab_replay.source: a reference study kept outside this repo (halves level-matched within 1 dB, the swap on the flip) + cuts/patterns.json story.abReplay

ears/mood.doc: optional zero-shot mood / genre labels per section from a local CLAP checkpoint (EARS_CLAP_MODEL)
ears/mood.source: optional; off without a local model

loudness.lra_note: house default for short-form social; linkedin.video wants <= 7 LU

tone.range_note: house default: per-octave band energy relative to the 500 Hz-2 kHz band. Set from the long-term average spectra of commercial mixes (bass about 6-10 dB per octave over 1 kHz, falling 4-5 dB per octave above it) and checked so that the pack's own demo masters do not trip it. Mud is also flagged when 250-500 Hz is above +4 dB and sits 4 dB over the straight line between the low and mid bands; voice-led mixes naturally sit +2..+4 there

speech.wpm_note: house default for voice-over; sentence-led on-screen type may run to 210 (3.5 words/s)

modes.music: music-led, cut-driven: >= cuts_on_onset_min of the cuts within cut_tolerance_frames of an onset (the critic rule)
modes.vo: VO-led: cuts sit under the voice and are judged by speech continuity (no cut inside a word, with word timings); cut sync is information only
modes.continuous: few or no cuts: the picture's motion events (plan.audio.events, --events, or measured from the video by tools/refstudy.py) within cut_tolerance_frames of an onset, >= cuts_on_onset_min

quiet.note: near-silence = 0.5 s blocks at least depth_db under the programme median. Planned regions (plan.audio.quiet [{t: [a, b], kind: open|dip|gap|hold, why}]) are intended shape: a quiet open of <= 2 s (the sound enters 1-2 s after a moving frame 0), a mid-film reset dip or trailer gap of <= 4 s, an end-card quiet hold of <= 9 s. Unplanned near-silence of unplanned_warn_s or more warns as dead air. The breath before the final sting is judged as before, and the last 0.15 s digital-zero rule is unchanged

bass_share_by_role.note: share of energy under 150 Hz as tools/refstudy.py measures it, from the round 4/5 references (docs/evidence/reference-round45-2026-10.md); brand_launch (50-60%) from two round 6 references, 55 and 58% (docs/evidence/reference-round6-2026-10.md), a thin base; information, not a verdict

structure.flat_note: the blindfold test of references/critic.md: no drop, LRA under 2 LU and half-second levels within 2 dB (P90 - P10) is flat

repetition.plan_note: a repeated plan id is a note up to 2 x max_repeats (the mixer round-robins takes)

ab_replay.doc: cuts/patterns.json story.abReplay holds the same numbers; halves matched within 1 dB and the swap on the flip frame come from two tier-A reference posts: tunable starting values
